description: This script manages the review lifecycle (start, stop, clear) for components based on their metadata.yaml files within a repository, facilitating review cycles with date calculations and updates.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds and lists all components with metadata.yaml files excluding docs and scripts directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the path to a component's metadata.yaml and exits if not found.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a future date by adding a specified number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Resets lifecycle date entries in a metadata.yaml file to an unset state.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG status report by calling an external script.
